Class PklPropertySourceLoader

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.pkl.env.PklPropertySourceLoader
All Implemented Interfaces:
io.micronaut.context.env.PropertySourceLoader, io.micronaut.context.env.PropertySourceLocator, io.micronaut.context.env.PropertySourceReader, io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered, io.micronaut.core.util.Toggleable
public class PklPropertySourceLoader extends Object implements io.micronaut.context.env.PropertySourceLoader, io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered
A PropertySourceLoader that evaluates application.pkl and application-{env}.pkl modules written in Apple Pkl and exposes the result as configuration.

An environment-specific module that declares no module header and no amends or extends clause implicitly derives from the base module: it extends the base module when that is declared open module, and so may add properties, and amends it otherwise, and so may only override what the base declares. Either way it only needs to state what differs. Evaluation runs in a sandbox: by default a module may import pkl: and modulepath: modules and read env:, prop: and modulepath: resources; a module loaded from the file system may also read files below its own directory. Additional patterns can be allowed with the micronaut.config.pkl.allowed-modules and micronaut.config.pkl.allowed-resources system properties (or the equivalent MICRONAUT_CONFIG_PKL_* environment variables), and evaluation is bounded by micronaut.config.pkl.timeout (10 seconds by default).

This loader deliberately does not extend AbstractPropertySourceLoader: the environment reads such loaders from an InputStream, which would hide the module's location and break relative amends and import clauses.

1.0.0

Graeme Rocher
